title: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
abstract: arXiv:2610.13811v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's labe

translated_title: QTestBench：一个用于评估大语言模型生成的量子代码的测试框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在经典代码生成方面已展现出优异表现，并越来越多地被用于编写保护代码质量的单元测试。然而，它们能否在量子软件领域做到同样的事情仍不明确，因为量子程序具有概率性、依赖于数值容差，并由特定领域的检查器进行评判，因此一个格式良好的测试仍可能与基准测试的判定结果不一致。现有的量子基准测试衡量的是模型能否产生正确的解决方案，但并未衡量其生成的测试能否区分正确的实现与错误的实现。我们提出了QTestBench，这是一个将大语言模型生成的量子测试套件与独立的基准检查器进行对比评估的框架，绝不将测试本身视为真值。对于每个任务，QTestBench会提示模型生成语法、语义和行为层面的测试，在运行时注入候选解决方案，并将每个测试的判定结果与检查器的标签进行对比。
tldr: 该论文提出了QTestBench框架，首次通过将大语言模型生成的量子测试判定结果与独立的基准检查器对比，来评估这些测试能否有效区分正确与错误的量子代码实现，而非将测试本身当作评估标准。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites by comparing their verdicts against independent benchmark checkers rather than treating the tests themselves as ground truth, measuring whether the tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones.
